in_sanskrit.name: Nabam
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the New
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nabam एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Nabam is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nava' meaning new, and 'Bam' meaning lord. This name is often given to a newborn child, symbolizing the beginning of a new life.
